# ibee_firewall_rule (Resource)

A rule inside an IBEE firewall group.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_firewall_rule" "https" {
  firewall_group_id = "FIREWALL_GROUP_ID"
  direction         = "ingress"
  protocol          = "tcp"
  port_start        = 443
  port_end          = 443
  remote_targets    = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  action            = "allow"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | allow or drop. |
| `description` | `string` | Optional |  |
| `direction` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `enabled` | `bool` | Optional, Defaulted | The public create API initially enables rules. When false, the provider immediately disables the rule via PATCH; attach the group only after its rules are created. |
| `firewall_group_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `port_end` | `number` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `port_start` | `number` | Optional |  |
| `priority` | `number` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `protocol` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | tcp, udp, icmp, or any. |
| `remote_targets` | `list(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | CIDR blocks, e.g. ["0.0.0.0/0"]. |
